Two Indian Companies Report Strong Q1 Financial Results

NIS Management reported a 35% increase in net profit for the first quarter, with income rising 16% to ₹116 crore and EBITDA up 36% to ₹9 crore. Chandan Healthcare also announced strong Q1 FY27 results, with total income reaching ₹82 crore. Their EBITDA surged 42% year-on-year to ₹21 crore, and profit after tax (PAT) rose 30% year-on-year.
